title: The creek
logline: A creek across the path. The glow on the water, upstream, warmer than the water has a right to be. The dog drinking. The man not crossing yet.

panels.composition: A creek crossing a forest path in February, stones, ferns, the water carrying the glow from upstream as a warmth on its surface. The pup drinking at the edge. A man's boots at the path's end, not stepping in. The far bank in ochre.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a forest creek crossing a needle path with ferns and stones, the water carrying a warm glow from upstream on its surface, a small three-legged dog drinking at its edge and a man's boots at the path's end not yet crossing, the far bank washed in ochre, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
